title: Kaleidoscopic Nutty Japanese Matcha Inari Zushi
description: A vegetarian-friendly Japanese dish featuring matcha and nutty flavors, perfect for a crowd-pleasing snack or lunch.
instructions: Rinse the Japanese short grain rice thoroughly and cook it according to the package instructions.
In a small saucepan, combine the rice vinegar, sugar, and salt, and heat the mixture over low heat, stirring until the sugar and salt are dissolved.
Allow the vinegar mixture to cool, then stir in the matcha powder until it is well combined.
Once the rice is cooked, allow it to cool, then mix in the matcha and vinegar mixture until the rice is evenly coated.
Cut the aburaage tofu pouches in half and blanch them in boiling water for 30 seconds to remove excess oil.
Drain the tofu pouches and fill each one with a small amount of the matcha rice mixture.
Serve the Inari Zushi at room temperature, garnished with sesame seeds and chopped walnuts.
To add extra crunch, sprinkle some toasted sesame seeds and chopped walnuts on top of the Inari Zushi before serving.
Store any leftover Inari Zushi in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours.
